Title: Azure Event Grid system topics support for resource management and health resources now in Public Preview

Body.Content:
With the rapid pace of cloud innovation and increasing demands of business, it’s never been more important to identify and address system disruptions quickly.  To help you meet this objective, Azure Event Grid has created a new system topic for Azure health resources and resource management events.

This new system topic utilizes Azure Resource Notifications (ARN), which means you can now receive near real-time alerts in Event Grid regarding disruptions from a wide range of publishers, allowing you to immediately begin mitigation activities. 

Learn More
